unsound) in Sri Lanka through the commencement,
promotion,  patronage  and  co-ordination  of
educational creative activities, vocational activities
and performing activities;
to  make  a  background  which  is  suitable  for  the
development of both mental and physical conditions

to  train  children,  youth  and  the  community  to
become  balanced  persons  who  are  contended  and
conversant  with  their  own  cultural  heritage  and
identity;
to establish peace among the multiple ethnic groups
in  Sri  Lanka  and  to  join  and  to  do  acts  in
collaboration  with  the  other  institutions  having
similar objects to those of the Corporation including
the  object  of  providing  facilities  in  order  to
exchange ideas, knowledge and experience;
